design.name: 穿山甲工匠武僧 (giant pangolin craftsman warrior monk)
design.role: 坦克：裂地重击（大尾砸地）/ 磐石壁垒（鳞甲张开）/ 厚皮
design.brief: A massive, very broad anthropomorphic Chinese PANGOLIN (穿山甲) craftsman warrior monk, the tank. Built like a barrel: huge rounded shoulders and back, thick arms, short sturdy legs, a short stylized snout (not long and thin), small calm determined eyes under heavy brows, a gentle smile. His own body armour is natural: big overlapping keratin scales cover the top of the head, the back, the outer arms and the long broad heavy tail, dark olive-bronze with worn gold edges, molten amber spirit fire glowing softly in the seams between the scales. Soft pale-cream face, throat and belly. Wears a saffron-orange warrior-monk robe tied off at the waist and draped over one shoulder, a deep teal sash, iron craftsman bracers, a leather tool apron with chisels and a small bronze plumb bob, wrapped shins and sturdy straw-and-leather sandal boots. Big human-like hands with FIVE digits each: a clearly separate opposable thumb on the inner side of the hand plus four separate thick fingers, five short blunt digging claws in total per hand (never four, never mitten-like paws). No held shield: all defence is his scales.
design.weapon: a heavy bronze drill-cannon shotgun held in the right hand, the long scaled tail raised high behind him mid ground-slam with amber cracks bursting from the ground, back scales flared open
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (no gun, no grenade, no weapons anywhere), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, calm expression
design.turnaround_pose: , the back scales lying flat and closed with the amber seams glowing softly (no sparks or effects), the long broad scaled tail extending straight backwards and slightly down behind the body with its tip just above the ground, fully shown in the side views
design.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread thick fingers ending in short blunt claws, both sandal boots complete.
design.style_note: The hand close-up must show the palm with the thumb sticking out to the side, clearly apart from the four fingers: count five claws.
